scenario: Authenticate Student, Faculty, Coordinator, Supervisor and Admin with real tokens; request workspace and forbidden API.
setup: Five active role accounts; authoritative Student internship.
expected: Correct account/role and dashboard; forbidden API returns 403.
passed_actual: All five roles authenticated, returned their dashboard/role and were denied the tested foreign role API.

scenario: Read Student dashboard, records, portfolio and Faculty progress for a current placement.
setup: Linked Student/program/department, Faculty, HTE, Supervisor and current placement IDs.
expected: All payloads identify the same Student, program, internship and HTE.
passed_actual: Dashboard/current placement, records, portfolio identity and Faculty progress matched the linked records.

scenario: Existing Supervisor accepts an invite; Faculty approves; read both workspaces and deny unrelated Supervisor.
setup: Existing account and profile; pending invite; current placement without Supervisor.
expected: No duplicate account; no assignment before approval; correct assignment and access afterward.
passed_actual: Existing account was reused; approval set both Supervisor IDs; Student/assigned Supervisor views matched and outsider form access was denied.

scenario: Clock 08:00–17:00 with a recorded 12:00–13:00 break; validate and compare progress.
setup: Active internship; frozen Manila time; no schedule override.
expected: One daily session, 8 credited hours, duplicate actions denied, progress changes only after validation.
passed_actual: Same session credited 8 hours; duplicates were denied; Student, Faculty and Coordinator progress showed 8 after validation.

scenario: Submit missing clock-out correction; require Supervisor then Faculty approval.
setup: Historical clock-in record and a correction request.
expected: No edit before both approvals; original/applied values and multiple audit entries preserved.
passed_actual: Early Faculty action was rejected; record stayed unchanged until both approvals; original/applied times and audit entries persisted.

scenario: Approve 08:00–17:00 Manila schedule; clock 13:00–17:00; validate and compare downstream hours.
setup: Approved work schedule and real clock actions at UTC instants corresponding to Manila times.
expected: Four credited hours in the log, dashboard, Faculty monitoring and FO-30.
passed_actual: Four hours propagate consistently.

scenario: Clock 08:01–17:02, compare attendance and portfolio FO-30, then Supervisor validates.
setup: Real API session; Supervisor signature test asset.
expected: Same dates/time entries/hours; no invented lunch; signature only after validation.
passed_actual: Attendance and FO-30 matched 08:01/17:02 and source hours; lunch fields stayed null; validation enabled the Supervisor signature.

scenario: Check first workday before/after shift end, afternoon session on next workday and later historical state.
setup: Approved 08:00–17:00 schedule; internship starts Sep 18; initially no attendance.
expected: No early absence; first completed day shown absent; afternoon present; historical session not active today.
passed_actual: All schedule/day-state checks hold.

scenario: Submit weekly journal; deny outsider Faculty/Supervisor; assigned Faculty approves; Student rereads.
setup: Submitted journal linked to assigned Faculty and Student.
expected: Only assigned Faculty review succeeds; reviewer/status persists and history updates.
passed_actual: Unrelated Faculty and Supervisor were denied; assigned Faculty approval/reviewer appeared in Student history.

scenario: Attempt review with Coordinator occupying faculty_id; inspect all downstream views before asserting denial.
setup: Coordinator-as-Faculty assignment; submitted journal.
expected: Faculty-only rule denies action; journal remains submitted in all views.
passed_actual: Denied review does not propagate.

scenario: Approve journal, reject overlapping submission and retrieve official form bundle.
setup: Real submitted/reviewed journal for Sep 7–11.
expected: FO-31 has correct Student, week, dates, content/status and no overlapping record.
passed_actual: FO-31 matched the approved journal and Student; overlapping submission was rejected and exactly one journal remained.

scenario: Read portfolio with one approved and one submitted journal.
setup: Two nonoverlapping journal records; one approved through API.
expected: Approved journal appears once; submitted journal is excluded.
passed_actual: Only approved journal is returned.

scenario: Upload PDF and approve as Faculty; compare dashboard, documents, monitoring and reports.
setup: One active upload template and stored PDF attachment.
expected: 0 approved before review; 1/1 and 100% in all six surfaces after approval.
passed_actual: PDF attachment persisted; approval changed all six tested compliance surfaces to 1/1, 100%.

scenario: Read authoritative Approved, Pending, Missing and Rejected requirement mix.
setup: Four active templates; three persisted documents in different states.
expected: Applicable denominator 4; approved 1; 25% across all six surfaces; pending/rejected preserved.
passed_actual: Student, Faculty, Coordinator and reports agreed on 1/4, 25%; pending/rejected each counted once.

scenario: Upload and approve both applicable requirements, then read all compliance surfaces.
setup: Two active templates, actual uploads and Faculty review actions.
expected: 2/2 and 100%; Faculty/Coordinator label Complete.
passed_actual: All six compliance surfaces showed 2/2, 100%; both monitoring views returned Complete.

scenario: Submit only FO-24 and inspect Host Evaluation status across six surfaces.
setup: Host Evaluation template; Faculty-opened period; Supervisor FO-24 submission.
expected: Host Evaluation remains unsatisfied on every surface.
passed_actual: Unrelated form does not satisfy Host Evaluation.

scenario: Coordinator attempts approval; inspect assignment, Supervisor list and Student display.
setup: Registered invite for existing Supervisor; internship initially has no Supervisor.
expected: Faculty-only rule rejects approval; assignment stays inactive.
passed_actual: Unauthorized approval cannot activate assignment.

scenario: Approve one registration and reject another; inspect faked mail and persisted assignment.
setup: Two real invite registrations; fake mail transport.
expected: Correct recipients/messages; duplicate approval denied; no tested plaintext password; rejection does not assign.
passed_actual: Correct approval/rejection emails captured; repeat approval returned 404; approval notice count was one; tested password absent; rejected invite remained unassigned.

scenario: Register with Acceptance Form; deny preapproval login; Faculty approves.
setup: New Supervisor registration via Student invite, PDF upload.
expected: Form stored, inactive/unassigned before approval, active/correct assignment afterward.
passed_actual: PDF stored; preapproval login denied; Faculty approval activated the new account and correct internship assignment.

scenario: Register Supervisor then try rejection without remarks.
setup: Student invite and valid Acceptance Form registration.
expected: 422 with remarks error; registered state and unassigned internship preserved.
passed_actual: Rejection without remarks returned 422; invite stayed registered and internship stayed unassigned.

scenario: Deny unrelated Supervisor then validate as assigned Supervisor and reread FO-30/progress.
setup: Actual 08:00–12:00 session.
expected: Only assigned Supervisor validates; 4 hours and validated state reach official form/Faculty.
passed_actual: Unrelated Supervisor was denied; assigned validation produced 4 hours in FO-30 and Faculty monitoring.

scenario: Faculty opens evaluation period; Supervisor submits FO-24; Student retrieves record.
setup: Assigned evaluator, internship and all ten ratings of 80.
expected: Submitted record keeps correct Student/internship, evaluator, form and score 80.
passed_actual: FO-24 persisted with correct evaluator/internship, submission timestamp and score 80; Student retrieved the same record.

scenario: Submit four official forms and Faculty evaluation; build Student portfolio.
setup: Approved period; Student/Supervisor/Faculty API submissions; signature fixtures.
expected: Correct official forms/scores/comments/signatures; no removed faculty_eval.
passed_actual: FO-22/23/24/03 appeared completed with checked content/signatures; weighted FO-24 score was 85; faculty_eval was excluded.

scenario: Read portfolio for an unsubmitted FO-24.
setup: Persisted FO-24 draft with null submitted_at.
expected: Portfolio retains pending state and null submission date.
passed_actual: Portfolio returned pending and null submitted_at for the draft.

scenario: Coordinator archives a conversation; Student checks own inbox; Coordinator restores.
setup: Persisted Coordinator-to-Student message.
expected: Archive affects only actor and is reversible.
passed_actual: Coordinator thread moved to archived while Student copy stayed active; unarchive restored Coordinator active thread.

scenario: Attempt outsider send/read against a persisted private thread.
setup: Student/Faculty private message and unrelated Student/Coordinator.
expected: Outsider send/read denied.
passed_actual: Unrelated Student send and unrelated Coordinator read both returned 403.

scenario: Student sends to Faculty; Faculty reads; Coordinator replies; Student lists threads.
setup: Four authoritative internship participants.
expected: Messages persist in intended threads and read state updates.
passed_actual: Faculty retrieved Student message and read_at was set; Coordinator message appeared in Student conversations.

scenario: Assigned Faculty schedules; Student reads; reject Student creation and reversed dates.
setup: Assigned internship participants; supported check_in type.
expected: Appointment visible only after authorized create; invalid requests persist nothing.
passed_actual: Faculty meeting appeared in Student list; Student creation and reversed dates were rejected without those records.

scenario: Unrelated Coordinator creates appointment; inspect database, creator/Student lists and notifications.
setup: Same-department Coordinator outside authoritative assignment.
expected: 403 and no row, attendees, visibility or notification.
passed_actual: Denied request leaves no downstream record.

scenario: Create opted-out and opted-in invitations; test recipient/read ownership.
setup: Student preferences toggled; unrelated user.
expected: Opt-out suppresses; opt-in creates correct invitation; no outsider leakage; owner-only read.
passed_actual: Opt-out suppressed Student invitation; opt-in created the matching message; outsider received none and could not mark it read; owner could.

modules: Profile + HTE + journals + attendance + evaluations + portfolio
scenario: Assemble broad portfolio after real journal/evaluation/text/image actions; check isolation.
setup: Approved journal; submitted FO-24; validated 4-hour record; logo/text; second Student journal.
expected: Correct identity, HTE, source records and uploaded content without duplicate selected sections/foreign journal/faculty_eval.
passed_actual: Portfolio matched identity/HTE, approved journal, 4-hour source, completed FO-24, essay and one logo; foreign journal and faculty_eval were absent.

scenario: Compare Faculty/Coordinator summary and performance against journals, evaluation, documents and validated hours.
setup: 8 validated hours with stored internship total 0; approved journal/document; submitted FO-24 score 80.
expected: Reports agree with source hours, HTE, journal/document counts and evaluation score.
passed_actual: All report values match authoritative sources.

scenario: Deny Student staff update; Admin disables/reactivates Faculty; exercise login and role APIs.
setup: Admin, Faculty and Student accounts.
expected: Status persists, disabled login denied, reactivated role works, audit excludes secrets.
passed_actual: Unauthorized update was denied; deactivation blocked login; reactivation restored Faculty access; audit contained no tested password/token fields.
